name: ask_user
description: Ask a human, another clanker instance, or (in a sub-agent run) the parent agent that spawned you, to choose between concrete options when guessing would waste work: which of two designs to build, which file to change, whether to widen the scope. Only for genuine forks where the options lead to materially different work — do not ask for permission to continue, and do not ask what you can determine by reading the code. Input: {"question": "...", "options": ["...", "..."]} (two or more), plus optional {"peer": "<instance name>"} to ask that peer, or {"parent": true} to ask your parent agent — the one holding the context your brief left out (sub-agent runs only; pick at most one target). Returns the chosen option verbatim and who answered. With no reachable answerer it returns an error saying to decide yourself.

options.description: Two or more concrete options, each phrased as the action it leads to.

peer.description: Name of a peer clanker instance to ask instead of the human (see the peers tool).

parent.description: true to ask the agent that spawned this sub-agent run instead of the human. Use when the decision hinges on context the parent has and the brief left out.
